scientific_integrity: The stated all-parameter conclusion follows from an explicit abelian-presentation proof; finite Smith-form tests corroborate but do not constitute an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete noiseless bispectrum and separate Fourier magnitudes; every Fourier coefficient on the specified notch support must be nonzero. No stability statement, partial-bispectrum theorem, or bispectrum-only magnitude identification is claimed. The first public source date is associated with the motivating source, not with this theorem.
title: Complete bispectral phase fibers for a cyclic low-frequency notch
